$comment: The operating-system and object-format identity predefines, and the platform surface each claims (P68, lane lm, #2). Six groups set six bits (main.c lists them); the exit is 42 only when all hold. DSS's ELF pairs predefined NONE of `__linux__`, `__linux`, `__gnu_linux__`, `__unix__`, `__unix`, `__ELF__` before this change (group 1 failed there: exit 62), so every `#ifdef __linux__` arm — sqlite's pread/pwrite, its mmap I/O and mremap — was skipped. On the Linux pairs the program exercises the surface the claims imply: getpid, open/write/lseek/read/close/unlink (the POSIX layer `__unix__` implies), pwrite/pread at an offset, ftruncate, a shared mapping grown by mremap and read back, munmap (what `__linux__` implies); on Darwin the POSIX arm runs too; on Windows neither is claimed. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-24 on this file: gcc 13.3.0 `-std=c2x` and clang 18.1.3 `-std=c23`, `-pedantic -Wall`, x86_64 Linux and aarch64 Linux (qemu), -O0 and -O2, exit 42 with no warning; mingw-w64 13.2.0 -O0/-O2 and MSVC 14.51 at its default and /O2 exit 42; a GNU-mode gcc build REFUSES it (`int linux = 5;` — gcc predefines `linux` outside the ISO modes), which is group 2's premise. The `release` arm runs the shipped optimizer pipeline over the same checks.
